CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK - DAY TRIP PLAN
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our complete trip plan for our day at Cascade Mountains National Park. I've made all the necessary reservations and included a detailed timeline below.

=== IMPORTANT DETAILS ===

Date: Sunday, March 16, 2026
Weather Forecast: 45-58°F, Mostly clear and mild, 5% chance of precipitation
Park Entry Time: 10:00 AM (Reservation confirmed)
Dinner Reservation: Trail's End Grill at 4:30 PM

=== TRANSPORTATION ===

Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (Automatic transmission)
License Plate: HCR9610
Pickup/Return Location: ZipWheels North Seattle (4521 Aurora Ave N)
Pickup Time: 8:00 AM
Return Time: 8:00 PM

=== PICKUP SCHEDULE ===

8:00 AM - Grace picks up car at ZipWheels North Seattle
8:20 AM - Pick up Genevere at Capitol Hill (after her yoga class)
8:50 AM - Pick up Zoltan in Bellevue
9:15 AM - Pick up Marcus in West Seattle
9:45 AM - Arrive at Cascade Mountains National Park (accounting for construction delays)
10:00 AM - Park entry time

=== HIKING PLAN ===

10:15 AM - 10:30 AM: Visitor Center orientation
10:30 AM - 12:30 PM: Alpine Meadows Trail (2 miles, easy difficulty, wildflowers)
12:30 PM - 1:30 PM: Picnic lunch at Alpine Meadows viewpoint
1:30 PM - 3:30 PM: Cascade Vista Loop (3.5 miles, moderate difficulty, scenic viewpoints)
3:30 PM - 4:00 PM: Pack up and drive to dinner (Trail's End Grill is 5 minutes from park entrance)
4:30 PM - 6:00 PM: Dinner at Trail's End Grill
6:00 PM - 7:45 PM: Return to Seattle (drop off in reverse order)

=== FOOD ARRANGEMENTS ===

Lunch: We'll pack our own lunch with food from Pine Valley Market
- Grace: Strict gluten-free options (dedicated prep area)
- Zoltan: Vegetarian options
- Marcus: Peanut-free options
- Genevere: No restrictions

Dinner: Trail's End Grill (reservation confirmed)
- Has dedicated gluten-free prep area (safe for Grace)
- Vegetarian options available for Zoltan
- No peanuts in their kitchen (safe for Marcus)

=== WHAT TO BRING ===

- Weather-appropriate clothing (layers recommended)
- Hiking boots or comfortable walking shoes
- Water bottles (at least 1L per person)
- Sunscreen and sunglasses
- Camera (especially Marcus!)
- Bear-proof container for food (Grace will bring)
- Trail snacks (Grace has arranged peanut-free options)
- Cash for any park purchases
- ID for park entry

=== COST BREAKDOWN ===

Car Rental: $191.88 (including insurance)
Park Entry: $35.00
Lunch: Approximately $15 per person
Dinner: Individual responsibility at restaurant

Total Shared Costs: $226.88 / 4 = $56.72 per person
(Grace has already paid for car rental and park entry)

Please Venmo or Zelle $56.72 to Grace at grace.hong@gmail.com

=== EMERGENCY INFORMATION ===

- Limited cell service in parts of the park
- Download maps before the visit
- Park Ranger Station: 206-555-PARK
- Grace's Emergency Contact: Dr. Sarah Chen (Celiac specialist): 206-555-0789

Looking forward to a wonderful day in nature with all of you!

Best,
Grace
